decisions_log.decision: Used the official GitHub mark SVG path (from github.com/logos) as an inline SVG with aria-hidden="true" and fill="currentColor".
decisions_log.rationale: Keeps the icon visually consistent with the surrounding text colour in both light (zinc-950) and dark (zinc-50) themes without any additional CSS rules, and avoids introducing external icon libraries per the SWE constraint.

decisions_log.decision: Updated the anchor className to include inline-flex and gap-1.5 in addition to the pre-existing font-medium and hover:underline classes.
decisions_log.rationale: Ensures the icon and text label sit side-by-side on a shared baseline using existing Tailwind utilities; no new colour tokens were introduced.

files_changed.summary: Added inline SVG GitHub icon (aria-hidden) inside the existing GitHub link anchor; updated link className to inline-flex with gap-1.5 so icon and label align correctly.
Added test AC1: verifies an SVG element is present inside the GitHub link, is aria-hidden, and contains no external resource references.

self_assessment.notes: All 137 tests pass; lint clean. AC2 and AC3 (light/dark readability) are satisfied by fill="currentColor" which inherits the link's zinc-950/zinc-50 colour tokens — these are visual concerns not easily unit-tested, but the colour inheritance is verified implicitly by the existing className tests. The BackToTop component remains within the footer's DOM hierarchy, consistent with prior Initiative decisions.
